FLAG FOR THE PM ARM: cultural responses to twin birth include TWIN INFANTICIDE. Where practised, the realised contribution of twinning to completed fertility is below the biological twinning rate — a correction the PM arithmetic does not currently carry, and it runs the same direction as differential twin mortality.
